QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_34

question.text: Within how many calendar days must a merchant banker redress an investor grievance under Regulation 8?

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 8 and the grievance redressal mechanism require that an investor grievance be redressed not later than twenty-one calendar days from the date of receipt of the complaint, with SEBI kept informed of the status. The Trap: 30 calendar days is a common regulatory timeline for other intermediaries and is the typical wrong guess; 15 days sounds investor-friendly but is not the prescribed limit. Note: The 21-calendar-day period is the outer limit prescribed under the Merchant Banker registration conditions for grievance redressal.
